detail.longDescription: Green build, slow pages. 136/136 Playwright tests passing tells you nothing about what they consumed. One bad browser tab can pin a CPU core at 90% while the machine average looks calm. So I built playwright-resource-monitor, a GitHub Action that wraps your Playwright run and fails the build on resource breaches: Watches machine CPU/memory and the worst single tab, the signal that actually matters Zero config: no reporter, no dependency, reads /proc on Linux Peaks recorded in the job summary plus cross-run history Silent and green when there's nothing to monitor Setup is one uses: step with four thresholds. Write-up with YAML, verdict rules, and honest limitations: https:// ozkanpakdil.github.io/posts/my _collections/2026/2026-08-30-playwright-resource-monitor/ # Playwright # GitHubActions # CI # DevOps # Testing
